Definition: the spine (as giving firmness to the body)
BiblicalUsage: The fat tail of the peace offering was burned on the altar, whole, and the word names the spine and the fat tail together. It appears only here, in the law of the offering.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the best part was God's portion, because the fat was His and the offering was made whole.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
